translation.name: Urim-Kalpm
translation.englishName: Urim: Wurkapm a Maur Wailen Portions

content: Maur Paitn Satan rkol Jisas ekg akal kil ngko kai paitn
Jisas kil nuhurn kop hu Jotan pa, kil ntie Maur Wor, yatom Maur Wor pa ak wiyel ye kai wrik kalpmel ur a ake melnum ur arke.
Kai wrik pa kil arpm tol wang kmel wekg (40) wa Maur Paitn Satan kil rkolel ekg akal kil ngko kai paitn. Ake kil al ekpma ur, tolpa kaingkai wang pa kai ekg akal plaln pa, nikgtel paitn wrijen.
Tolpa yatom Maur Paitn Satan pa la nasel la tolpa, “Kitn ti Warim a Maur Wailen, ti kitn la ekg weij ti paln tol ekpma pa ekg kitn il.”
Ari Jisas akalmpe la tolpa, “Wurkapm a Maur Wailen pa la tolpa, melnum ake ntie ekg arpm ak ekpma hute.”
Wa Maur Paitn Satan pa ak wiyel wa kai kaino atn wrik tipmningken watin ur pa, yatom aktutu tolti paln plantel wrik knokg, a ha kweiur kweiur wrongwailet a atn knokg ti.

Yatom kil la nasel la tolpa, “Kupm akal ukweitn titnongket ekg kitn ikghlen kweiur kweiur worwor wrongwailet a atn knokg ti. Kweiur kweiur wrongwailet ti apm pike eln kul wam alkupmen ti ase. Ti kupm akal uk kai mla ur a kupm akal uk pa, pa kupm uk tolti.
Ti tol kitn kpor klko lein kupm ti pa, kweiur kweiur wrongwailet pa alkitnen plaln.”
Ari Jisas akalmpentel la tolpa, “Wurkapm a Maur Wailen pa la tolpa, ‘Kpor klko lein Wailen, Maur Wailen alkitnen, wa kat nang alkilen wrij tolti.’ ”

Ake kil wa ngko, tolpa yatom wa Maur Paitn Satan wa ak wiyel ye kai Jerusalem pa, yatom wiyel ye kaino atn kaino wan kmpo kwa a wan yalming a Maur Wailen pa. Yatom kil la nasel tolpa, “Kitn ti Warim Kpman a Maur Wailen pa, kitn tpra itn ti eln kinar knokg ai!
Ro hel kai Wurkapm a Maur Wailen pa la tolpa, ‘Al kil nasi tu maur akwapel alkilen ti ekg al tu atnenteitn ariworwor pa.’
Wa ro tolpa yat, ‘Al tu wamalilnteitn, tolpa ti ake al kitn kwat nepm hel weij ur pa, kalpm.’ ”
Ari Jisas akalmpentel la tolpa, “Wurkapm a Maur Wailen pa la tolpake, pake wa la yat tolkil, ‘Ake al kitn uktiel Wailen, Maur Wailen alkitnen ti.’ ”
Maur Paitn Satan kil uktiel Jisas kai kweiur kweiur wrongwailet pa plaln pa, wa kil wa nuhurntel kai pen.
Jisas katen kwap alkil atn kai Kalili
Yatom Jisas wa kaino ha knokg Kalili namponen titnongket a Maur Wor. Wa yangkipm a la kiti kil pa apm kai hor ha knokg yampingken tiur pa ase.
Kil ro tukgunakg lngkep a tu kinkpman wrongwailet pa atn wan alntuen a tu atning yangkipm a Maur Wailen atne pa, wa tu wrongwailet pa tu kat nang akil pa.
Tu Nasaret uk yirokg Jisas

Jisas kil wa kai Nasaret, ha a pike kil wreitn wail atne pa. Ak wang a tu Juta ark ekg yapm pa, kil kai kahor wan a tu atning yangkipm a Maur Wailen atne pa, kil aklei wang pa apm ak tolpake. Yatom kil wreitn atn akal klein wurkapm a Maur Wailen pa.
Yatom tu wi wurkapm a melnum ek wripm Aisaia pa ukwel, yatom kil ari om kil wi wurkapm pa kil halken kor yangkipm ur a ro tolpa,

“Maur Wor a Wailen arpm kupm, ekg nte, kil alkil akrkahantopm akal kupm laron yangkipm wor a Maur Wailen nasi tu melnum a arpm warkip. Wa kil kwaopm akal kupm laron yangkipm pa ekg akwi tu melnum a ark wan tipmning pa ye kulhor hen. Wa la nasi tu mla ur a ikg paitnen pa wa tu ikg nungkwat ari kweiur kweiur. Wa kupm nar akal kwan kalkut a tu ye a wleket a tu ukwen pa ekg al tu arpm kulkula wor.
Wa laron nasi tu wrong kinkpman pa tolpa wring ti pa, wring a Wailen akal rein aklinjen.”
Kil klein plaln pa wa kil wale wurkapm pa uk kai melnum a ikghlen wurkapm pa, wa kil eln nar arpm. Ari tu wrong kinkpman a arpm kahor wan pa, tu ikghnentel titnongket.
Yatom kil wa la nasen la tolpa, “Yangkipm wurkapm a Maur Wailen wet kipm atning a kupm klein kil pa, apm paln ek arke tike.”
Tu kporn yangkipm tolpa yangkipm a kil la pa wor, wa tu wreitn paitn ekg atning yangkipm wor a paln kai ek alkilen pa. Wa tu la nasi tita la tolpa, “Plpa warim kpman a Josep!”

Ari Jisas la nasen la tolpa, “Al kipm wi yangkipm kla a tu la tolpa, ‘Kupm melnum a ntekg hi numpet pa, tolpa ti kupm ntekg kupm alkupm ti paln wor hep pen.’ Kipm wakrongen ekg al kupm ntekg kuina ur atn ha alkupmen ti yat, tukol a pike kipm atning a kupm ntekg atn kai Kaperneam ai.”
Wa kil wa la tolpa, “Kupm la nasepm aklahle wrijen, tu melnum ur ake ntie ekg atning nungkulkg yangkipm a melnum ek wripm ur atn ha alkilen pa.

Tukol pike hep ak ai Ilaija kil arpm, ak wang pa hu ake wei atn tol wring wraur mit wompel, yatom wa wang nikg wail palnten hor ha knokg a Israel pa. Yatom ak wang pa tu kin karpikg wailet ark kai Israel pa. Pake kupm la nasepm aklahle wrijen,

la tolpa Ilaija ake pike Maur Wailen kwa kai ekg akal kil aklin tu kin karpikg a arpm Israel, ha yiprokg alkil pa, kalpm. Kil pike kwa kai ekg kin karpikg wrij ur kai Sarepat kai ha knokg manet ur a Saiton ai.

Wa tukol tu melnum wailet a Israel pa tu wi numpet a hi kark ak wang a Ilaija kil atn melnum ek wripm ti, ake wrij ur alntuen a arpm ha alkil pa paln wor pa, kalpm. Naman, melnum wrij ur hute kai ha manet ur a Siria ai pa paln wor.”
Tu wrongwailet a ark kahor wan a tu atning yangkipm a Maur Wailen atne pa, tu atning yangkipm a Jisas la tolpa yatom, tu ipma wakget paitn wrijen.

Yatom tu wreitn tolti rkol wampel Jisas pa ye kahor hen a ha wail pa. Ha wail pa tu kat ark wrik krongkwangken ur, wa tu rkol wampel talpul eln kinar tolpa yewel kinar tipmning. Tu yewel kinar akal pilntel eln kinar tipmning watin ari kalpm,
kil nuhurnten tolti, kil ngkom hor kuin a tu wrongwailet pa apm kai ase.
Jisas kwan maur paitn a arpm melnum ur
Yatom kil kinar Kaperneam, ha wail ur a ha knokg a Kalili. Ak wang a arpm ekg yapm pa kil katen kwap a ro tukgunakg lngkep a tu.
Tu wreitn paitn itnen yangkipm a kil rowen tukgunakg lngkep pa, ekg nte, yangkipm a kil laronten pa kil laron namponen titnongket.
Melnum ur a maur paitn arpme pa kil apm arpm kahor wan a tu atning yangkipm a Maur Wailen atne pa. Yatom kil wlakil yikaktnen
la tolpa, “Ei, Jisas a Nasaret! Kitn akal ntekg kuina ur kul ekg men ti? Kitn kul akal ntekg men ti kai paitn aki? Kupm arieitn pa, kitn pa melnum wri wor a Maur Wailen.”

Ari Jisas kil kle maur paitn pa la tolpa, “Hmpri ek akitn pa, hor kai tukulein melnum pa!” Yatom maur paitn halik melnum pa eln kai ngko arpm kai kuin a tu ai, wa wreitn hor tukuleinjel, wa melnum pa ake wa kil wi paitn ur.
Tu wrongwailet tu wreitn paitn la nasi tita la tolpa, “Kil pa la yangkipm kuina tolpa? Kil pa kil melnum a nang itne ntie titnongket ekg la tu maur paitn pa kulhor kai tukulein pake?”
Yatom tu ye yangkipm a la kiti kweiur kweiur wrongwailet a kil ntekg pa ye kai hor ha wrongwailet a ark yampingken pa.
Jisas kwan numpet a tu melnum wailet
Jisas kil nuhurn wan a tu atning yangkipm a Maur Wailen atne pa, wa kil kai wan a Saimon. Wa man yalmpikg a Saimon pa kil numpet num wakget wail paitn, yatom tu ropontel ekg kil akal aklinjel.
Yatom kil kai atn yampingken wrik a man pa, yatom kil la titnongket kwan numpet pa tukuleinjel, yatom numpet pa kai plaln. Wa kil wreitn pirpiren ntekg ekpma kweiur kweiur pa ekg tu pa.
Takgni kai kinar tmpal ti pa, tu wrong kinkpman tu ye tu a wi numpet wrongwailet pa ye kul ekg Jisas. Yatom kil eln wam pa hel tu melnum a numpet pa wrij wrij, om ntekg numpet a tu pa paln wor.

Wa maur paitn wailet, tu hor kai tukulein tu wrong kinkpman wailet pa, wa tu wlakil tolpa, “Kitn pa Warim Kpman a Maur Wailen!” Ari Jisas klewen loken la tolpa ake akal tu ekla. Ekg nte, tu ari la tolpa kil pa Krais.
Jisas piln yangkipm hor wan a tu atning yangkipm a Maur Wailen atne

Takgni pa no rkapen pa, Jisas kil wreitn nuhurn ha pa, wa kil kai wrik hampen ur pa. Tu wailet ripa nel korel hor pa kai, tolpa kai hantilel kai wrik a kil kai arpme pa. Yatom tu akal lokel, ekg ake al kil nuhurnten.
Ari kil la nasen la tolpa, “Kupm akal laron yangkipm wor a la ekg Kingdom a Maur Wailen hor ha wail tiur ai yat. Ekg nte, Maur Wailen apm kwaopm nar ekg akal akwap a tolpake.”
Kil la nasen tolpa plaln, kil laron yangkipm a Maur Wailen pa tolpa kai atn wan a tu atning yangkipm a Maur Wailen atne hor ha knokg a Jutia.
